create.name: WCCM Italia (Comunità Mondiale per la Meditazione Cristiana)
create.bio:
WCCM Italia is the Italian community of the World Community for Christian Meditation. Founded in Florence in 1996, it is now based in Brescia, where the bishop recognised it as a private association of the faithful in 2007. It teaches the way of silent prayer handed on by John Main and Laurence Freeman: a regular time of stillness, morning and evening, in which the meditator repeats a single prayer word and lets go of thoughts and images.

Thirty-odd weekly groups meet in about ten Italian regions, each with a leader who welcomes newcomers and passes on the basic teaching. A national council organises silent retreats, conferences and a six-week introductory school, and volunteers translate the weekly readings and teachings from the international community into Italian. Its website shares these weekly teachings, a guide to meditating and a Sunday evening online group, and members can join silent weekends such as its Advent retreat at the hermitage of Lecceto near Florence.
